title: Week 4: Pipes, Logging & Scripts
description: Session II: Build data pipelines (cut, sort, uniq -c, head, wc -l), master output and error redirection (>, >>, 2>, 2>&1, tee, date), and write executable Bash scripts with variables and read -p. Verified by IITM Jarvis Linux Club.

steps.title: Task 1: Pipes as Data Pipelines (cut, sort, uniq -c, head, wc -l)
Task 2: Redirection for Logging (>, >>, 2>, 2>&1, tee, date)
Task 3: Introduction to Shell Scripting (shebang, chmod +x, vars, read)
